europe_now.title: Widespread Clashes and Protests Across France
europe_now.summary: Tens of thousands of demonstrators have taken to the streets across France in cost-of-living protests, leading to fires, barricades, and violent clashes with police forces in several cities.

sources.headline: Live: Protesters clash with police, set fires as tens of thousands march across France

top_stories.title: Mass Demonstrations and Violent Clashes Erupt Across France
top_stories.summary: Tens of thousands of people joined protests across multiple French cities over the rising cost of living. Clashes broke out between demonstrators and police as Yellow Vests and other groups mobilized alongside students.

top_stories.title: Pope Leo Discharged from Hospital Following Surgery
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo has been discharged from the hospital and returned to the Vatican. The pontiff's departure came four days after undergoing surgery for lung cancer.

sources.headline: Pope Leo returns to Vatican four days after lung cancer surgery

top_stories.title: Zelenskyy Warns of Winter Blackouts Amid Shifting Alliances
top_stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that Russia intends to create nationwide power blackouts in Ukraine ahead of winter. Amid deteriorating relations with Donald Trump, the Ukrainian leader actively sought to consolidate support across Europe.
